test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate one-word substitution of the given group of words.**

Something that is absolutely necessary, that you cannot do without.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Indispensable**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In the given question the phrase can be substituted using option 2.
 
• **In option 2, "Indispensable" means something that is absolutely necessary, that you cannot do without.**
 
• It is an adjective that describes something that is essential or vital. 
 
 
• Example: Oxygen is indispensable for human survival.
 
 
 
• The other given options are not suitable for the given phrase.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Insular means narrow-minded or isolated from outside influences.
 
• Isolated means separated or detached from others.
 
• Intolerant means unwilling to accept or respect different opinions or beliefs.
